name: Egrovesys Contact Form Builder
author: eGrove Systems

sections.description:
The Egrovesys Contact Form Builder is a feature-rich WordPress plugin designed to help users easily create, customize, and manage contact forms for their websites. It features a drag-and-drop form builder, dynamic field population, email template customization, and robust security enhancements. Perfect for websites of any size, it simplifies form management for admins and provides a seamless user experience for visitors.

Features

Custom Form Creation and Management

  • Create, edit, and delete forms through an intuitive admin interface.
  • Support for custom post types for efficient data handling.
  • Field validation for input types such as text, email, etc.

Drag-and-Drop Form Builder

  • Easily add, rearrange, and customize fields like Name, Email, and Phone.
  • Customize field labels, placeholders, required status, and more.
  • Real-time preview of form updates.

Dynamic Country, State, and City Dropdowns

  • Populate state and city fields dynamically based on the selected country.
  • Country, state, and city data is loaded from local plugin data files.

Email Template Configuration

  • Admin and user email template customization.
  • Use dynamic placeholders (e.g., {name}, {email}) for personalization.
  • Toggle between HTML and plain text formats.
  • Test email functionality included.

Form Submission Management

  • Securely store form submissions in the database.
  • View, filter, and download submissions (CSV format) from the admin panel.

Form Layout Configuration

  • Choose between List View or Grid View for field arrangements.
  • Customize layouts dynamically with instant updates.

Form Appearance Customization

  • Customize colors, font sizes, border styles, and submit button appearance.
  • Apply real-time changes to match your website’s branding.

Enhanced Security Options

  • Integration with Google reCAPTCHA.
  • Honeypot fields for bot detection.
  • Enable or disable security options via settings.

Shortcode Functionality

  • Embed forms on any page or post using a shortcode (e.g., [egsacfb_custom_form id="1"]).

External services

This plugin can connect to external services only when the related feature is enabled by the site administrator.

Google reCAPTCHA: Used for spam protection when the reCAPTCHA option is enabled. The visitor response token and site key are sent to Google when a protected form is loaded or submitted. Service provider: Google. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Egrove license validation service: Used to validate and deactivate license keys for plugin licensing. The site URL, license key, and plugin identifier are sent when an administrator activates, validates, or deactivates a license. Service provider: Egrove Systems. Terms: https://www.egrovesys.com/terms-condition-use/ Privacy: https://www.egrovesys.com/privacy-policy/

This plugin does not use RestCountries, Google Fonts API, or example.com APIs in the WordPress.org version. Country/state/city data is loaded from local plugin data files.

Support

For issues or feature requests, please contact us via the support forum or at our website.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0 License. See License URI for details.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, choose the .zip file, and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I add a new contact form to my website?

A: Go to the Forms menu, click Add New Form, and use the drag-and-drop builder to customize your form. Copy the generated shortcode (e.g., [egsacfb_custom_form id="1"]) and paste it into any page or post.

Q: Does this plugin support reCAPTCHA?

A: Yes, the plugin integrates with Google reCAPTCHA to enhance form security.

Q: Can I customize the email templates?

A: Yes, email templates can be customized for both admins and users. You can also test templates using the built-in Send Test Email feature.
